recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle outdoor portrait of two men in urban streetwear, framed by a heavy, rusted industrial chain that cuts diagonally across the foreground. The lighting is harsh, direct sunlight creating deep shadows, set against a clear blue sky and weathered wooden textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal chain acting as a leading line and framing device
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the subjects' presence
High-contrast interplay between bright sky and dark clothing
Textured industrial elements contrasting with smooth sky
coreInvariants: Heavy rusted metal chain in the foreground
Subjects wearing dark hoodies and beanies

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects; one in the mid-ground left, one slightly further back right, both occupying the central vertical third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The thick, rusted chain entering from the top-left and curving toward the bottom-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye follows the chain from top-left down to the subjects, then up to the top-left typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of clear blue sky in the upper right quadrant.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and dark charcoal (clothing and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Rust brown and weathered wood (foreground textures)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky, high contrast in the subjects, muted earthy tones in the industrial elements.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy stroke weight with minimal contrast
White fill with thin dark drop shadow or outline for legibility

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating over the sky and foreground elements
Anchored to the bottom right corner

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform family pairing using different weights and scales of the same heavy sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Drop shadows for legibility against complex backgrounds

preserve: Italic slant for the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, slanted, clean aesthetic of the primary text.
Provides the necessary weight and urban feel.
Alternative for high-density, high-impact display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photograph of two men in black hoodies and beanies standing in an industrial yard. A thick, rusted iron chain must cross the foreground diagonally from top-left to bottom-right. The background should be a clear, bright blue sky and weathered wooden posts. Use harsh, direct sunlight.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add extra-bold, slanted sans-serif text in the top-left corner in white with a thin black outline. Add a three-line stack of bold sans-serif text in the bottom-right corner in white with a black drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the chain prominent and rusted?
Is the sky a saturated blue?
Is the typography heavy and slanted?

adjustableVariables: Degree of slant in the typography
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the chain does not obscure the subjects' faces entirely.
Check that the white text is legible against the blue sky.
Verify the low-angle perspective creates a sense of scale.
Confirm the color palette remains grounded in urban/industrial tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Low-Angle Urban Portrait] + [Industrial Foreground Element] + [Heavy Slanted Sans-Serif Typography] + [High-Contrast Sunlight].
